follow-up time: Until surgery (before the age of 1 year)
outcome: Perinatal features (gestational age, birth weight, birth length, head circumference)
Rate of prolonged or difficult delivery
cohort: 36 children (25 boys) who underwent cranial vault remodeling for primary sagittal synostosis before the age of 1 year, compared to official statistics of all Finnish newborns from the year 2010 (n = 61,371)
finding: Newborns with non-syndromic sagittal synostosis had similar birth size and gestational age compared to the general population but had significantly higher rates of Cesarean section, suction cup delivery, and prolonged or difficult delivery.
mod_finding: The rate of Cesarean section was significantly increased (30.5%) in newborns with non-syndromic sagittal synostosis compared to the general population (16.6%).
birth_weight: 3565.8 g (average for boys), 3197.2 g (average for girls)
